Microsoft Edge WebView2 SDK

The `include/WebView2.h` header and x64 `WebView2LoaderStatic.lib` are from the official `Microsoft.Web.WebView2` NuGet package, version 1.0.4258.31. The accompanying `LICENSE.txt` and `NOTICE.txt` are from that package.

The static loader is linked into the application. The Evergreen WebView2 Runtime itself remains a Windows prerequisite and is not included here.
